title: SMR Alpha Claim Semantic Trace to Alloy Bridge

components.name: Developer
components.responsibility: Submit one exact Plan and review accepted Claims, semantic differences, bounded findings, and unknown scope.
components.authority_role: May initiate and observe preflight; no implicit acceptance authority
components.multiplicity: One or more developers per Product.
prohibited_authority: Must not treat bounded evidence as Product acceptance or compliance.

components.name: Released host and managed MCP
components.responsibility: Capture exact Plan bytes, submit typed commands, and render typed results.
components.repository_runtime: Bicameral host adapter and MCP runtime
components.multiplicity: One adapter per active host session.
prohibited_authority: Must not infer missing Plan text or manufacture semantic findings.

components.name: Local Bicameral daemon
components.responsibility: Pin identities and orchestrate projection, validation, alignment, snapshot serialization, bounded analysis, candidate staging, and rendering.
components.authority_role: Validates and derives; separate Candidate Promotion owns accepted append
components.multiplicity: One daemon coordinates many immutable Product-scoped analyses.
prohibited_authority: Must not accept Claims during projection, analysis, or preflight.

components.name: Specialized semantic trace provider
components.responsibility: Run the exact smr-claim-trace-alpha-v1 profile and project exact Plan text into a candidate hypergraph grounded by supplied immutable source-unit IDs.
inputs: ExtractionProfileV1 with explicit provider and model identity
Exact Plan bytes and source-unit IDs
components.multiplicity: One execution per immutable trace identity; retries reattach.
prohibited_authority: Must not emit executable Alloy, use a silent provider/model alias, or write accepted state.

components.name: Trace validator and Claim aligner
components.responsibility: Validate extraction identity, source-unit references, graph integrity, partial selectors, and state-identity relations; resolve exact source spans deterministically; then compare each assertion with the pinned accepted hypergraph.
components.multiplicity: One result per trace and accepted-base identity.
prohibited_authority: Must not repair omitted meaning or force ambiguity into equivalence.

components.name: Exact hypergraph snapshot serializer
components.responsibility: Serialize the complete supported accepted and proposed Candidate Promotion hypergraphs into the stable Alloy meta-model with exact bounds and provenance.
components.multiplicity: One byte-stable snapshot per immutable projection identity.
prohibited_authority: Must not semantically select a slice, invent records, or omit supported alpha-domain records.

components.name: Stable Alloy model and bounded analyzer
components.responsibility: Load reviewed meta-model/checks, exact snapshot data, and explicit scope in Alloy 6.2.0 with SAT4J and the pinned distribution digest; return bounded typed evidence.
components.repository_runtime: Pinned Alloy distribution invoked by bicameral-bot
components.multiplicity: One execution per snapshot, check, analyzer, and scope identity.
prohibited_authority: Must not read raw Plan text, mutate accepted state, or claim global safety.

components.name: Accepted SMR hypergraph projection
components.responsibility: Serve pinned accepted Claims, ClaimAssertions, ModelAtoms, AtomRelations, and provenance.
components.authority_role: Read model of canonical Product history
components.multiplicity: One position and digest per Product analysis base.
prohibited_authority: Must not accept bridge writes or mix projection positions.

components.name: Local derived-analysis store
components.responsibility: Persist rebuildable Plan, trace, snapshot, result, candidate, and preflight artifacts by immutable identity.
components.multiplicity: One store may contain many Product-scoped analyses.
prohibited_authority: Must not become canonical Product truth.

transitions.trigger: Exact Plan has no reusable current trace.
transitions.persistence_effect: Persist validated candidate hypergraph or incomplete receipt; no canonical change.

transitions.trigger: A valid consequentially grounded trace or supported partial selector, its alignment, and the pinned accepted alpha domain are available.
transitions.persistence_effect: Persist complete exact derived snapshot and provenance.

transitions.trigger: Projection is terminal but the trace is invalid, empty, unsupported, or consequentially ambiguous.
transitions.persistence_effect: Render a typed incomplete result without serializing a snapshot or invoking Alloy.

transitions.trigger: Valid exact snapshot and named check are available.
transitions.persistence_effect: Persist bounded evidence; canonical Product state unchanged.

transitions.trigger: Trace, alignment, and analysis have terminal derived outcomes.
transitions.persistence_effect: Render read-only result with Claims, candidates, bounded evidence, scope, and unknowns.

scenarios.name: Mixed Plan produces complete bounded preflight
scenarios.trigger: Plan contains accepted, contradictory, novel, and unresolved assertions.
scenarios.expected_result: Every assertion remains distinct; complete supported records serialize exactly; bounded findings map to source and Claims.
scenarios.failure_behavior: Invalid, ambiguous, unsupported, timeout, or missing closure remains visible and never becomes false-safe.

scenarios.name: Reviewer approval conflicts with accepted authority
scenarios.trigger: Plan says Reviewer approves while accepted Claim authorizes only Product Owner.
authority_boundaries: Accepted authority remains canonical; counterexample remains evidence
scenarios.expected_result: Actor difference and bounded unauthorized trace render with exact provenance.
scenarios.failure_behavior: Ambiguous actor or missing closure produces visible unknown scope.

scenarios.name: All supported hypergraph records serialize exactly
scenarios.trigger: Serializer receives pinned accepted alpha domain and validated Plan hypergraph.
authority_boundaries: Canonical projection to derived structural copy
scenarios.expected_result: Counts, IDs, memberships, relations, and provenance round-trip exactly under exact Alloy bounds.
scenarios.failure_behavior: Any omission, duplicate, invented tuple, or unresolved ID rejects the snapshot; a complete snapshot beyond configured capacity returns capacity_exceeded without slicing.

scenarios.name: Invalid or consequentially incomplete trace stops before Alloy
scenarios.trigger: The provider returns an empty, invalid, unsupported, or consequentially ambiguous trace.
scenarios.expected_result: No Alloy snapshot or result is created; preflight reports trace_invalid, ambiguous_scope, unknown_scope, or unsupported_extraction_profile.
scenarios.failure_behavior: No-counterexample, clear, safe, or compatible output is forbidden.

scenarios.name: Retry and restart reattach
scenarios.trigger: Same immutable request repeats after timeout or restart.
scenarios.expected_result: Same trace, snapshot, analysis, candidate, and result identities are reused.

scenarios.name: Provider and analyzer cannot mutate accepted semantics
scenarios.trigger: Provider or analyzer output attempts to declare acceptance or suppress limitations.
authority_boundaries: Untrusted/derived output to canonical store boundary
scenarios.expected_result: Forbidden fields or writes are rejected; accepted store remains unchanged.
scenarios.failure_behavior: Any canonical write is a release-blocking failure.

conformance.required_behavior: Every assertion and semantic relation preserves source spans, semantic dimensions, partial selectors, state identity, graph relations, alternatives, and unknowns under an exact extraction profile.
conformance.prohibited_fallback: Impact-atom bag, default/latest model alias, span invention, omitted-dimension repair, or silent ambiguity repair

validation_obligation.description: Extraction-profile, schema, span, graph, partial-selector, state-identity, fail-closed, minimal-pair, and mixed-Plan fixtures.

conformance.required_behavior: Retrieval relevance, semantic relationship, partial-selector compatibility, state identity, and candidate disposition remain separate.
conformance.prohibited_fallback: Exact atom retrieval treated as semantic equivalence, unknown dimensions filled into a full tuple, or adjacent states collapsed

conformance.required_behavior: Every supported accepted and proposed record serializes exactly once with stable provenance and exact bounds, or the serializer returns capacity_exceeded before analysis.
conformance.prohibited_fallback: Intelligent slicing, record omission, invented tuple, silent bound increase, or generated semantic rule

validation_obligation.description: Count, ID, tuple, membership, provenance, and exact-bound round-trip tests.

conformance.owner_module_or_seam: Reviewed Alloy meta-model, checks, and sandboxed analyzer
conformance.required_behavior: Stable hand-written checks run only against exact snapshot data under explicit finite bounds.
conformance.prohibited_fallback: LLM-authored Alloy, unbounded default, or no-counterexample rendered as safety

validation_obligation.description: Pinned Alloy tests for instance, unsat, counterexample, no-counterexample, timeout, and malformed result.

implementation_evidence: Planned stable Alloy model and analyzer tests

conformance.required_behavior: Projection, serialization, analysis, and preflight leave canonical Product state unchanged.
conformance.prohibited_fallback: Automatic promotion or analyzer-authored accepted facts

validation_obligation.description: Accepted projection and event-store digests remain unchanged across all bridge fixtures.

conformance.required_behavior: Every finding resolves through snapshot records to exact Plan assertions, accepted ClaimAssertions, Claims, spans, and scope.
conformance.prohibited_fallback: Free-form explanation without typed provenance or hidden limits

validation_obligation.description: Golden result fixtures round-trip all finding provenance.

conformance.required_behavior: Identical immutable inputs reattach to one trace, snapshot, analysis, candidate, and result identity.
conformance.prohibited_fallback: Duplicate work, stale-base reuse, or silent scope substitution

validation_obligation.description: Interrupt every stage, restart, retry, and compare identities and canonical-store invariants.
